rules: Every source catalog row is represented exactly once.
Rows mapped to the same bounded CCB contract are consolidated at the CCB surface; raw competitor names are retained for traceability.
covered-contract means a current bounded CCB source contract exists; it does not imply live qualification.
probe-required and unsupported-creator rows receive no behavioral parity credit.
intentional-exclusion rows are accounted design decisions, not missing registrations.
liveWitnessFiles records witness source presence only; runtime qualification remains governed by evidence artifacts and portfolio state.

rows.description: Align or distribute multiple 2D nodes relative to each other by their cc.UITransform bounding boxes. Nodes may live under different parents — alignment is computed in world space and each node position is updated in place. Mode "align" snaps all nodes to a shared edge or center: left/right/center align horizontally, up/down/middle align vertically (needs >= 2 nodes). Mode "distribute" spaces nodes evenly along horizontal or vertical, keeping the two outermost nodes fixed (needs >= 3 nodes). Rotation and non-uniform scale are accounted for.
rows.rationale: A bounded CCB contract represents the same agent-facing workflow.
